sources.label: Патчи Morphe для VK Мессенджера
sources.author: Patches VK Messenger
patch_list: App icon colors
Recolors the launcher icon: the cyan plate, the blue speech bubble and the white dots.
Bypass security and package checks
Bypasses package verification in AuthBridge and BuildInfo to prevent profile crash and unofficial client warnings, disables dangerous app detection, and disables VPN detection.
Bypass VPN detection
Bypasses VPN and proxy detection across the application so messages and calls work over VPN.
Clone app
Changes the package name to com.vk.im.morphe so VK Messenger can be installed side-by-side with the official app.
Disable telemetry
Disables MyTracker analytics. VK's internal AppStartReporter / BaseAnalyticsSender are intentionally left intact because they carry notification-sync/heartbeat traffic.
Fix push notifications
Sends the official package name and signing certificate in Firebase requests, so a re-signed or cloned app gets an FCM token and receives push notifications in the background.
Fix Tracer manifest for clone
Points the OK Tracer manifest at the cloned package name, otherwise its upload thread throws IllegalStateException and takes the app down on login.
Native anti-tamper bypass
Neutralizes the signature checks in libvkmedia.so that exit the process when the APK carries a custom signing key.

patch_list: Bypass security and package checks
Bypasses package verification in AuthBridge and BuildInfo to prevent profile crash and unofficial client warnings, disables dangerous app detection, and disables VPN detection in music.
Clone app
Changes the package name to com.vk.im.morphe so the messenger can be installed side-by-side with the official one.
Disable audio ads
Disables audio ads in the VK music player by routing to the built-in stub ads component.
Disable telemetry

Fix push notifications
Sends the official package name and signing certificate in Firebase requests, so a re-signed or cloned app gets an FCM token and receives push notifications in the background.
Hide clips ads
Removes commercial video ads, market promos, and sponsored content from VK Clips.
Hide feed ads
Hides sponsored posts, ad cards, story ads, promo banners, and shopping ads wherever VK Messenger shows posts, stories, services, or clips. Recommendations are left intact.
Native anti-tamper bypass
Neutralizes signature and integrity checks in libvkcore.so and libvkmedia.so to prevent crashing on custom-signed APKs.
Video ads
Blocks video player in-stream advertisements (prerolls, midrolls, postrolls, ad overlays), attached promo ad cards below videos, and VK Video / RuStore download prompts.
